build.command: cd apps/dag-ui && npx vite build --config vite.config.ts

build-api-server.//: Runs cargo directly, not through a just recipe: the visual-docs capture runs this target in a container with no just. The binary goes to target/dag-ui-api, which no other build names, and its units go to this clone's shared build directory, target (CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR, set through env so no shell has to quote TOML). No RUSTFLAGS here: they would fingerprint the units this build shares with the test tiers under a second flag set, and _crate-lint already denies warnings over this binary target.

lint.command: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check apps/dag-ui && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 apps/dag-ui

test.command: cd apps/dag-ui && npx vitest run --config vite.config.ts
